studies.title: Echo sounding
studies.caption: Reginald Fessenden's oscillator sends sound to the sea floor and times the echo; the German Meteor expedition of 1925–27 makes 67,000 soundings with it.
studies.prompt: Close cabin view aboard a1920s survey ship, operator monitoring an early electromechanical echo-sounding apparatus with analog dials and paper recording, a small adjoining pencil study of hull-mounted transducer and sound path down to sea floor. No digital sonar monitor or multicolor bathymetry.
